claim: The cheapest possible CMP_EQ dispatch -- one extra opcode decrement reusing a free subroutine slot, a two-line gate instead of a second exit block, reuse of the existing op1/op2 classification, and only two new flags -- still does not assemble. All four routes to the unified image now fail, and the failure cell does not track the amount of code added: the minimal patch fails FURTHER from the limit than the larger one did.

design: one extra opcode decrement (dec4) reusing SUBROUTINE_FLAG4, which the op2 phase uses later and which is cleared when consumed
the exit block's FLAG4 line redirected to a two-line gate (ret_dec_gate) that tests CMP_GATE and otherwise runs the original ret_op2_dec1 body -- not a second exit block
result selection reuses the existing op1 and op2 classifications (FLAG_OP2_IS_1/2/3 and the op1 decrement carries); the {0,1,2} domain makes those exact, so equality needs one test per op1 class
CMP_RESULT branches added at the four op1 classification tails

errors: Error: Free space exceeded (Add Malbolge command).
Internal error: Cannot generate initialization code for cell 58152.
Error: Memory usage conflict while generating initialization code.

finding: The failure cell does not track added code: the minimal dispatch (~60 lines, 2 flags) fails at 58,152 while a larger dispatch failed at 58,969. LMAO's initializer layout is non-monotonic, so predicting which patch fits is not possible without assembling.
What is stable across all four: the unified image does not assemble. The binding constraint is the Classic 59,049-cell tape together with LMAO's initializer, and no dispatch variant tried fits.
The closest attempt remains the compressed one on the arithmetic image (80 cells from the limit), so if a fifth variant is tried, varying that patch is the best starting point.
what_is_demonstrated_for_b: The arithmetic half alone: mbir_m2_alu.hell loads a 7-byte stored program and executes ADD/SUB, 8/8 on both engines.
The loader half alone: mbir_m2_loader.hell loads prog_0..3 and runs them by PC, 4/4.
The 7-byte load extension and the opcode dispatch structure assemble on the loader's andamio (unified_loader_gen.py).
what_remains_not_demonstrated: One image that loads a stored program and executes ADD/SUB/CMP_EQ: four measured attempts, all rejected.
The 5+2 xlat2 borrow comparator in HeLL (E1 design, never built).
scope_limits: The 'from the limit' column is the repo's working interpretation of the failure cell; it is a relative measure, not an exact byte count.
Only the dispatch was varied; the arithmetic engine itself was never tuned for size.
